---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea for a new feature, mechanic, or improvement
title: '[Feature] '
labels: 'feature, needs-triage'
assignees: ''
---

**What is your idea?**
A clear and concise description of the feature or enhancement you want to see.

**Why is it needed?**
Explain the problem this solves or how it improves the game. (e.g., "Right now, it's really frustrating when..." or "This would make combat feel much more...")

**How should it work? (Optional)**
If you have a specific vision for how this should look, feel, or function, describe it here.

**Reference / Inspiration (Optional)**
Are there other games that do this well? Add screenshots, videos, or links to help illustrate the idea.

**Additional context**
Add any other thoughts or context here.
